freeze_scope: The formulas, event inclusion rules, splits, costs, and reporting cells in this file are fixed before running research/regime_eval.py. No thresholds are selected from outcomes.

data.source: Existing saved Bitget candle snapshots and existing signal exports only; no network calls.
data.signal_timestamp: Saved event signal_time_utc denotes the candle OPEN label. Match this exact timestamp to the snapshot bar; all features use data through that bar's close (timestamp + timeframe duration), never later bars.
data.split_rule: Development if entry-bar OPEN timestamp < split; out_of_sample otherwise. Existing event export period must agree with this rule.

volatility.feature: For each bar i in a contiguous cadence segment, TR_i = max(high_i-low_i, abs(high_i-close_(i-1)), abs(low_i-close_(i-1))). The normalized bar range is 10000 * TR_i / close_i basis points. Feature V_i is the arithmetic mean of normalized ranges for bars i-19 through i inclusive.
volatility.warmup: Requires 20 consecutive bars for V and 100 prior valid V values in the same contiguous segment for regime thresholds; otherwise volatility regime is unavailable and the event is omitted from regime cells.
volatility.reference: For each signal bar i, compare V_i against the preceding 100 valid V values V_(i-100) through V_(i-1), excluding the current value.
volatility.terciles: Sort those 100 prior values ascending. Compute q(p) by Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear interpolation at h=(n-1)*p, zero-based, p=1/3 and p=2/3. Low if V_i <= q(1/3); middle if q(1/3) < V_i <= q(2/3); high if V_i > q(2/3). Equality belongs to the lower adjacent bucket. Tied thresholds may leave a bucket empty.

trend_range.warmup: Requires 21 consecutive closes in the same contiguous segment. If the denominator is zero, define ER20 as zero.
trend_range.fixed_context_threshold: Range if ER20 <= 0.30; trend if ER20 > 0.30. The threshold is fixed, not tuned.

causal_features.availability: Feature assignment is based solely on completed bars at or before the signal bar. Outcome labels, future highs/lows/closes, failure flags, and delayed-entry diagnostics are retrospective descriptions and are never model/predictive features.

strategies.dashboard_breakout: Existing Treppen dashboard breakout event export; no signal logic is recomputed.
strategies.three_close_momentum_baseline: Existing three-close momentum event export; no signal logic is recomputed.

existing_event_analysis.baseline_integrity: Before analysis, verify event-export SHA-256, row counts, and per-symbol/strategy/side/period counts against the saved source summary JSON. Verify each event entry timestamp equals signal bar timestamp + one timeframe and its exported period agrees with the fixed entry split. Do not mutate imported helper globals.
existing_event_analysis.outcomes: Use saved one-following-bar gross_bps, mfe_bps, and mae_bps. Keep favorable/adverse excursion separate from gross close-to-close return and do not call any of them portfolio P&L.

cost_scenarios_round_trip_bps.22: 12 bp fee scenario plus 10 bp assumed round-trip spread/slippage.
cost_scenarios_round_trip_bps.37: 12 bp fee scenario plus 25 bp assumed round-trip spread/slippage.

existing_event_analysis.cells: Report both strategies independently by group (btc_eth, alts, stock_perps), side (long, short), entry period (development, out_of_sample), and volatility bucket; separately report the same dimensions by trend/range context. Emit every Cartesian cell, including zero-count cells.

fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.box: At signal bar i, use exactly the preceding 12 consecutive bars (i-12..i-1); box_high=max(high), box_low=min(low), midpoint=(box_high+box_low)/2. Qualify only if midpoint>0 and (box_high-box_low)/midpoint <= 0.02.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.breakout: Long if close_i > box_high and close_(i-1) <= box_high; short if close_i < box_low and close_(i-1) >= box_low. This is a close-confirmed first crossing of that bar's trailing box boundary. Long and short are evaluated independently. Every qualifying crossing is retained; overlapping boxes/events are not deduplicated.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.entry: Immediate diagnostic entry at the next bar OPEN (i+1), exactly one bar after the signal close. Immediate one-bar gross return exits at that bar CLOSE; MFE/MAE use that entry bar's high/low.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.failure_label: FAILED at the first offset k in {1,2,3} if bar i+k closes inside the breakout bar's frozen box, inclusive of either box edge (box_low <= close <= box_high); record only that first offset even if later bars re-enter again. If no close is inside, label NONFAILED with no_failure_in_three_bar_window. This is retrospective only, not a feature or entry filter.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.late_entry: Separate fixed one-bar-delay diagnostic: enter at bar i+2 OPEN and exit at bar i+2 CLOSE, holding exactly one bar. Compute its own one-bar gross return/MFE/MAE and costs; never subtract an invented latency or infer fills. Report first-failure timing relative to this delayed entry: offset 1 is before delayed entry, offset 2 is its entry/holding bar, and offset 3 is after its exit bar.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.denominators: Count all qualifying close breakouts first. Report eligible complete-window count, failed/nonfailed counts and failure fraction using only complete, non-crossing windows; separately report missing-window, split-crossing, and feature-unavailable counts. For each eligible complete non-crossing denominator, report first-failure counts at offsets 1, 2, and 3 plus no-failure; these mutually exclusive counts must sum to the denominator. Relate the same offset counts to the delayed-entry timing. A missing or crossing label is not a nonfailure. Immediate and delayed returns each use their own explicitly reported complete-data denominator.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.window_completeness: The signal bar and all three following bars must exist at exact timeframe cadence in the same contiguous symbol segment. Any gap, missing bar, or end-of-file before i+3 makes the outcome window incomplete and excludes the outcome label/return from outcome statistics; retain and count the qualifying signal in the all-breakout denominator.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.split_contamination: The split is by immediate entry-bar timestamp. For development breakout diagnostics, require the immediate entry and every bar in the three-bar failure window to be before the split. For OOS, require the immediate entry and all three window bars at/after the split. Otherwise mark split_crossing and exclude from both periods' outcome statistics. Do not let future bars across the boundary label a development event.
fixed_box_breakout_diagnostics.cells: Report the fixed-box diagnostics by group, side, entry period, volatility bucket and trend/range context with all empty cells present. Report failure timing/counts independently from return/excursion summaries.

gaps_warmup_and_arithmetic.cadence: Use exact 5-minute or 15-minute timestamp increments. A gap or duplicate timestamp breaks a segment; no feature warmup, prior-100 threshold history, box, ER, or forward outcome window may cross it. Duplicate timestamps are rejected as invalid input.
gaps_warmup_and_arithmetic.warmup_reporting: Count source events with unavailable volatility feature, unavailable trend/range feature, and either unavailable feature. These do not silently enter an 'unknown' market regime cell.
gaps_warmup_and_arithmetic.floating_point_edges: Use ordinary IEEE-754 double arithmetic; compare normalized range <= 0.02 and ER20 <= 0.30 as written, with no epsilon or rounding before classification. Quantiles interpolate from unrounded feature values.
gaps_warmup_and_arithmetic.short_period_limitations: The fixed preceding-100-value tercile reference and 20-bar range feature create a substantial initial warmup; per-symbol feature availability is reported. Short samples can produce sparse/empty group-side-period-regime cells, unstable means/rates, and tied tercile boundaries.

interpretation_limits: Exploratory reuse of the already examined 45-day, 12-symbol panel; the named OOS period is not fresh or independent validation.
Purposively selected current contracts, no point-in-time universe correction; asset group results are event-weighted.
Signals overlap in time and across symbols. No portfolio allocation, leverage, funding, liquidation, execution, spread, queue, market impact, or dependency-adjusted inference is modeled.
One-bar gross return and MFE/MAE are event outcome descriptors, not realized P&L. Cost-adjusted return is scenario arithmetic, not measured execution.
Multiple comparisons, dependence, sparse cells, and short OOS duration limit inference. No profitability or regime-efficacy claim.
